verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an API that can 'connect to any existing object' in the account and push or map custom resources. It also offers an MCP server for accessing and managing controls, tests, vendors, frameworks and risks, which suggests broad programmatic coverage. Nothing states full UI parity, and many UI workflows show no API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API docs covering Trust Center admin, policy editing, access-review decisions and Comply AI features, write-operation coverage details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
